title: Sustainable corrosion prevention of mild steel in acidic media with Rumex Nepalensis herb extract
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,924-937
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA07958B, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Amrita Kumari, Navneet Kaur, Manvinder Kaur, Fohad Mabood Husain, Pradip K. Bhowmik, Harvinder Singh Sohal
Rumex nepalensis shows eco-friendly potential as a green inhibitor for MS corrosion in 1 M H2SO4, achieving 98.35% efficiency with a protective barrier confirmed by weight loss, contact angle, UV-Vis, and SEM.
